entries.en: to discard, remove; to throw away
entries.notes: M 栏末音节 T99 污损难辨（cû paû gì gì buc 之尾），词义据 L/H/R（Desechar／去／giù）定为丢弃。

entries.en: to throw away, toss aside; to discard

entries.zh: 嫌：嫌弃，厌恶而不加理会
entries.en: to dislike, disdain; to reject without regard

entries.zh: 除：除去，除掉；嫌弃而排除
entries.en: to remove, get rid of; to discard
to fling aside, reject; to refuse
entries.notes: M 栏『pèng . l . pià』中『l.』为稿本缩记，展开属推断（或示口语异读 pià）；词义据『Desechar, no querer』定。

entries.en: to discard, abandon; to refuse
to cast off; to refuse, not want
entries.notes: M 栏『ng say: ùi gì̃』与 R 栏『N̂g』与『委』字常音不合，词义系据西语及下文『委棄』条推断。

entries.en: to refuse, decline; to reject
entries.notes: 西语栏末段『g los lestren』损坏不可解，词义据汉字『却』及 M/R 栏。

entries.zh: 棄嫌：嫌弃，看不上而不理会
entries.en: to disdain, reject; to take no notice of
to break off (friendship); to sever relations

entries.zh: 見却：见而却之，当面回绝
entries.en: to reject on sight, dismiss outright
entries.notes: 西语栏末『loş ledan』损坏不可解，词义据汉字『見却』及 M/R 栏。

entries.zh: 委使：弃置不用；打发遣走
entries.en: to discard; to dismiss, send away
entries.notes: 『委使』对 Desechar 之义属推断（委而不用）；M/R 栏『ng』读法存疑。

entries.zh: 委棄：委弃，撒手抛弃；弃置不顾
entries.en: to cast off, abandon; to dismiss from one's hands

entries.zh: 棄物：弃物，被丢弃之物，废物
entries.en: a discarded thing, cast-off object
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉文与官话栏俱[残]，M 栏仅存『joa.』一音节；西语词头 Dejambarcar（当即 Desembarcar『下船』）虽可辨，材料不足不敢定夺。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头『Defambardar ux』损毁不可解，汉文仅存『…通』，官话栏[残]且 M 栏尾音 T99，材料不足。

entries.en: to disembark; to unload, take down (cargo)
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 整行划删之废稿（L 栏仅见起首『Dese…』，M 栏注整行划删），汉字『屏／屁』存疑，不敢定夺。

entries.zh: 馬頭：码头，泊船装卸之处
entries.en: wharf, landing place, jetty

entries.zh: 開劍鞘：拔剑出鞘，打开剑鞘
entries.en: to unsheathe the sword, open the scabbard
entries.notes: 汉字标注[疑:劍/鉸]字形未定；词义据西语 Desenvainar la espada 及 M/R 栏。

entries.en: to draw out; to unsheathe (the sword)

entries.zh: 開刀：拔刀出鞘，亮出刀刃
entries.en: to unsheathe the knife, draw the blade
